header: Picture credits as label and value pairs
text: One to thirty credits in a description list. What is being credited on the left, the rights holder on the right, and the licence short name as a second description on the same term.
note: Long lists read better in two or more columns; the pairs flow down each column rather than snaking across them.

rows.title: The title is what is credited
rows.text: The text is the rights holder

rows.title: A credit under a licence
rows.text: The value becomes a chip under the holder

rows.title: The chip is text in a badge
rows.text: so the licence is read out with its credit
